reviews.text:
Since getting my cat, I've tried to avoid traveling as much as possible, but this time I had no choice but to leave my beloved cat alone for 2 nights and 3 days.

I was very anxious, but the staff were incredibly kind and attentive from the initial consultation onwards, which allowed me to leave home with peace of mind.

The actual service was also very thorough, and I was very grateful that they reported on everything via LINE. My cat seemed to have become very attached to the sitter, and I could tell that she really enjoyed the time they spent together ♡

Also, they were really good at taking pictures, and I was so happy to receive so many cute photos!

All the sitters have a deep love for cats, and I am completely satisfied with every aspect of the service. If I ever need to leave my cat alone again, I would definitely like to ask for their help.

They are truly wonderful pet sitters, and I can entrust my precious cat to them with complete peace of mind.

Thank you so much for everything!

Gunji

I requested SHIRO to care for my two cats for three days during the Obon holiday. I was very grateful that they were able to accommodate my request despite it being a last-minute inquiry.

The reports on the cat-sitting were thorough, including photos and videos, which gave me peace of mind while I was away from home.

My two cats seemed to be having a great time, and I looked forward to receiving the reports.

This was my first time requesting such a service, so I was a little anxious at first, but I would definitely like to ask SHIRO for help again in the future.

I requested care for a kitten less than six months old.

We met in person, including the kitten, and had a detailed discussion before the sitter agreed to care for the kitten, which gave me peace of mind!

After each care session, I received detailed reports with many adorable photos and videos. The sitter's approach and personality were so kind that the kitten seemed very relaxed.

Thank you so much for your consistently courteous service! I always feel at ease knowing you understand my pet's situation and provide detailed reports.

I will continue to use your services in the future!

We always feel confident entrusting our cats to you because of your consistently polite and loving service! Thank you so much as always.

Initially, we were worried about whether our sensitive cats would accept a sitter, but all those worries were completely dispelled. They became so attached to us, like family, and it was truly touching! We also get to see new sides of them that we don't usually see, which is something we look forward to!

We had given up on traveling for a long time, but we feel completely at ease leaving our cats in SHIRO's care, so we would definitely like to ask for your help again in the future! Thank you again!

Thank you so much for your continued support!

Thank you for sending so many photos and videos each time, and for providing such detailed reports on my cat's condition; it gives me complete peace of mind. 😌
I'm also so happy and grateful that you bring my cat's favorite toys and play with her so much! 🥲♡
You are a trustworthy sitter who takes such good care of my cat with such meticulous attention to detail!

I look forward to continuing to work with you in the future!

Thank you for your continued support.

I entrust you with the care of my 1.5-year-old Chiweenie puppy.

Due to the nature of my work, I frequently have to travel for work on short notice, so I have left a spare key with you.

I am always grateful for your willingness to accommodate my requests as much as possible.

You send me many photos and videos of my dog's care, and the reports you write are always thorough, so I feel completely at ease leaving him in your care.

I appreciate that you play with him with toys in the room until the very last minute.

I've been entrusting him to you since he was a puppy, and he wags his tail happily whenever he sees the faces of those who come to care for him.

I would like to continue to ask for your help in unavoidable situations.

My beloved miniature dachshund is always thrilled when you come, and I feel at ease leaving him in your care as you always provide courteous and honest service.
He doesn't like being left alone in a cage at a pet hotel, so I'm very grateful that you can care for him at home, and I'm glad you share photos and videos of how he's doing each day, so I can keep up with him when I'm away for long periods at work.

I'm so grateful to have found a trustworthy pet sitter, and I'll definitely continue to use your services in the future ☺️

I have a cat that I would like you to take care of while I travel. You send me detailed reports, adorable photos, and videos, which I enjoy watching while I'm away. One time, a feather from a cat toy I had at home went missing, so I contacted you out of concern that my cat might have swallowed it. The feather wasn't there to begin with, so it wasn't swallowed, but I was relieved to hear from you.

I use her services when I'm on a business trip or when I have to work overtime and am late. She's always kind and polite, and a very reliable sitter.
My dog ​​has become very attached to her.

I always feel completely at ease entrusting my dog's walks to you.

I really appreciate the detailed reports you send, complete with photos.

We use this service during the New Year holidays and when we're on long trips.
The process involves an initial consultation and meeting with the sitter, followed by visits while our family is away.
During visits, they take care of our cat's basic needs, such as feeding and litter box use, and we receive text, photos, and videos via LINE showing them playing with our cat, which gives our family peace of mind. Our children, in particular, eagerly await the sitter's messages and are reassured to see how happy our cat is.
Our cat also seems to like the sitter; she always greets her with her belly exposed, purring happily as she receives treats.

I've used the service twice and it was excellent.

I have two timid cats, and I expected them to hide and not come out while I was taking care of them, but one of them gradually became interested in the sitter and I was surprised to see her playing with toys with him. I think the sitter was very skilled. (They even sent me a video of the care session.)

The other cat didn't come out, but I was impressed by how the sitter quietly checked on him and left him alone.

I think it was a good distraction for the cats while I was away.

I will definitely use the service again if the opportunity arises.

Thank you so much for all your help. The videos and photos you send show that the cats are relaxed and happy while you're away. Our two calico brothers are rescue cats and were initially quite shy, but they've completely warmed up to you and seem to enjoy playing. Our veteran calico cat is quite elderly now. We appreciate you taking care of her at her own pace.

Thank you so much for your kind and gentle approach every time.

I've used SHIRO's services twice, and I was completely satisfied! They visited beforehand, carefully coordinated everything, and my cat seemed very happy and relaxed. I requested their services while traveling, and they took and shared plenty of photos and videos.

This is a sitter you can trust!
I've asked them to look after my two cats three times in the past.
Each time, they carefully keep me updated with photos, videos, and text about the cats' litter box and feeding habits, as well as their overall condition.
From the videos, it seems the cats have grown attached to the sitter, so it's clear that they treat animals with love.
They respond quickly to things like estimates for sitting fees, receipts for payment, and receipts for the house keys, which gives me peace of mind.
I would definitely like to continue using their services in the future.

I feel completely at ease entrusting my pet to them because they always take such excellent care of my cat.

I really appreciate them sending lots of videos and photos of my cat while I'm out. (They're very good at taking pictures, and I always look forward to them.)

My cat is quite wary, but she naturally warms up to the sitter and seems relaxed every time.

I plan to continue using their services in the future. I'm so glad I found such a trustworthy pet sitter.

I always ask her to sit my two cats, and I feel completely at ease knowing that she takes such careful care and reports to me! My cats have become very attached to her. I hope to continue working with her for a long time to come.

I regularly request their services, and I'm truly grateful for their very courteous support! They also point out small details that I notice, which is very helpful. The flexibility they have in adjusting the service schedule makes things easy, so I plan to continue using their services in the future!

I received detailed information, including temperature and humidity, as well as photos and videos, every time. Furthermore, they handled any problems calmly and professionally. I feel confident entrusting them with my pet's care again next time.

I was able to confirm the safety of my cats 😺😺 through detailed reports, numerous videos, and photos while I was away, which gave me peace of mind. I want to be with them as much as possible, but when I absolutely have to leave them alone, I would like to ask for your help again. …
They send lots of photos and communicate politely.

I always rely on your services when I travel. I really appreciate the detailed reports you send each time.

I especially enjoy your excellent photography; it makes my trips more enjoyable! I definitely want to continue using your babysitting services in the future. :D

This was my first time using a pet sitter service, and I'm truly grateful for their exceptional service.

I trust them completely and would like to use their services again in the future.

They came together for the initial consultation and listened carefully to my needs, which put me at ease.

I could also feel their deep affection for my cat.

Their flexible approach and suggestions were very much appreciated.

I'm also grateful for the detailed video reports and care they provided while I was away!

I ask them to take care of my cat when I go away overnight.
They always provide very detailed reports. They send me videos and photos of my cat having fun while I'm traveling, so I can enjoy my trip with peace of mind!
I'd like to continue using their services in the future 😊 …

This was my first time using their services.
Reservations and inquiries were made smoothly via LINE.

My cat was shy, so I asked them to keep an eye on him, and they were very knowledgeable in inviting him to play, which I really appreciated!
The sitter was kind, so I was able to leave him in their care with peace of mind ♡
They also took great photos and videos of him while he was being cared for!
I look forward to seeing you again next time ☺

I requested cat sitting services for my two cats during a 2-night, 3-day trip.

We had a preliminary meeting at my home, where I was able to explain detailed care methods and points to note, including creating a medical record, which gave me peace of mind.

On the day of the service, I received a call before the visit and was able to see how things were going with photos and videos, which was very helpful.

All communication was done via LINE, which made it easy to check things.

I received a PDF estimate for the cat sitting service and a key deposit receipt (just under 10,000 yen for two cats, one visit per day for two days).

Normally, my cats hide when guests are over, but they came out on their own to play with toys and get treats when the sitter arrived – truly professional!

Overall, I felt very at ease, and I would like to use the service again.

The best pet sitter ever! ✨ She's truly trustworthy, someone I'd want to rely on for life.

Until last year, I used a local pet hotel for short stays of one or two nights, but after leaving my dog ​​there for over a week in the summer, she became ill (even experiencing bloody stools for the first time in her life – heartbreaking!). This experience made me lose faith in the hotel's environment and service, and I deeply understood the loneliness and suffering my dog ​​endured. From then on, I decided to stop using pet hotels.

I was a little apprehensive about using a pet sitter service, as I had no prior experience, but I decided to try this local service in October 2024, as it had overwhelmingly positive reviews.

From the initial consultation, the representative was incredibly professional and reassuring. Then, on the day of our first pet sitting experience, while my husband and I were away, they sent us numerous videos and photos of our dog, along with a very detailed report – I was truly amazed.

Furthermore, the videos clearly showed how much she loves animals and how lovingly she treats them, which deeply moved me.

That's when I decided to ask Shiro-san to help again, and I made my second request in March.

Just like the first time, I was once again deeply impressed by her meticulous reports, numerous videos and photos, and courteous service. ☺️

Although her service area is limited, I wholeheartedly recommend her to all pet owners throughout Japan. ✨
I look forward to continuing to work with her and my poodle! 💕

*The attached photos were taken by the sitter, and I'm always touched by how cute they are; I save them every time. ☺️

Thank you very much. 
I was grateful that you were willing to accept my sudden request. 🙂‍↕️ …

They kept me updated on my cat's condition in great detail, which made me feel at ease when I went home for the holidays ✨️
My cat is very affectionate towards the sitter ☺️
I'm always grateful.
I'll definitely ask for your help again when I travel or go home for the holidays ☺️

I felt completely at ease entrusting my dog ​​to the sitter because of the thorough pre-care meeting and the careful attention given to helping my shy dog ​​get used to the sitter.

I also appreciate the detailed updates on how my dog ​​was doing during the sitting.

I look forward to using your services again in the future.

I requested care for two days.
They took lots of photos and videos during care and shared them on LINE. I felt reassured being able to check in on my beloved cat while I was traveling.
They paid attention to even the smallest details, and I was happy that they wrote a long, detailed care report.
I'll request their services again!

I asked them to look after my toy poodle when I'm away from home. They send me videos, photos, and detailed reports in real time, so I can leave it in their care with peace of mind. Thanks to them, my dog ​​seems to be able to spend time at home without any worries. I would definitely like to ask them for help in the future.

This was my first time using a pet sitter. I have a 7-month-old female British Shorthair. To be honest, I was initially a little nervous about having someone other than family members come and go from my house while I was away. However, …

I highly recommend them.

During the initial consultation, they thoroughly confirmed everything from …

I rely on them when I can't take my dog ​​for walks due to family circumstances. They seem used to interacting with dogs, and my dog ​​has completely warmed up to them. I also trust them to wash my dog's paws and hand over the keys after walks.

Dear Miho Tagomori,
Thank you so much for your continued patronage.
We are very happy to receive such a high rating!
We look forward to seeing your adorable cat again.

They always keep a close eye on my dog ​​and take care of him according to the situation, so I feel at ease leaving him in their care. My dog ​​is very shy, but I can see that he is gradually getting used to the sitter. I would like to continue using their services.
Thank you for the meticulous care you provided. The service exceeded my expectations. Sending photos and videos to keep me updated was very reassuring. Thank you very much.
